Docs / API Surface
Stackyard API Surface

Services and Endpoints

Base URL is the Stackyard listener (default http://localhost:4566). AWS-compatible services require SigV4 signing and use standard AWS headers.

For the new docs experience, see Stackyard Web Docs: AWS Services.

Core

Health and debugging endpoints.

Auth: none
Supported Actions

Action Type: HTTP request action

Method Path Description
GET /_stackyard/health Service status payload.
GET /_stackyard/debug/request Echoes method, headers, and query string.

Invoke Behavior

Invoke supports both deterministic mock mode and local code execution mode.

  • Execution mode: Configure STACKYARD_LAMBDA_EXECUTION_MODE=mock|local (or CLI --lambda-execution-mode). Default is mock.
  • Local workspace: Optionally set STACKYARD_LAMBDA_WORK_DIR (or --lambda-work-dir) to control where code archives are unpacked during local execution.
  • Supported runtimes in local mode: provided* (bootstrap), python*, and nodejs*.
  • Versioned code fidelity: PublishVersion snapshots function code; invoking a specific version or alias executes that published snapshot instead of current $LATEST.
Invocation Type Behavior
RequestResponse Executes immediately. In local mode, runs unpacked function code and returns function output payload. In mock mode, echoes request payload (or {"statusCode":200} when empty).
Event Returns 202. In local mode, execution is triggered asynchronously in a background goroutine.
DryRun Returns 204 without executing code.

On runtime failures in local mode, Stackyard returns 200 with error JSON payload and sets X-Amz-Function-Error: Unhandled. Stderr is surfaced in X-Amz-Log-Result (base64).
